# AMS Solutions

> AMS Solutions is a comprehensive medical billing and revenue cycle management company serving healthcare providers across multiple specialties with billing, coding, credentialing, and practice management consulting services.

AMS Solutions specializes in outsourced medical billing and RCM services for diverse healthcare practices. The company offers specialty-specific solutions tailored to anesthesia, cardiology, dermatology, orthopedics, mental health, and other medical practices, with nationwide service coverage and expertise in healthcare compliance and claim processing.

## Key Topics

- Medical Billing Services
- Revenue Cycle Management
- Healthcare Credentialing
- Practice Management
- Claim Processing
- ICD-10 Coding
- CPT Coding
- HCPCS Codes
- Medicaid
- Healthcare Compliance
- Billing Outsourcing
- Denial Management
- Collections
- RCM Consulting
- Specialty Billing

## Core Services

- [Services - AMS Solutions](https://ams-solutions.com/services): Main services: billing, coding, credentialing, collections, and RCM support
- [Medical Billing Company in Dallas, TX | AMS Solutions](https://ams-solutions.com/services/billing): Medical billing services in Dallas with charge entry, payment posting, audits
- [Practice Management Consulting - AMS Solutions](https://ams-solutions.com/services/practice-management-consulting): Practice management consulting for workflow optimization and profitability
- [Credentialing Services for Insurers | AMS Solutions](https://ams-solutions.com/services/credentialing): Credentialing services for hospital privileges with Medicare, Medicaid support
